close_reason: fixed: unimplemented header forms (AsAddresses, AsGroupedAddresses, AsDate, AsMessageIds, AsURLs) marked with NOT IMPLEMENTED comments plus debug eprintln warnings; contributors can no longer accidentally overwrite them
description: email.rs apply_header_form returns Value::Null for AsAddresses, AsGroupedAddresses, AsDate, AsMessageIds, AsURLs. These are the forms callers are most likely to request by name. validate_header_form only rejects cross-type combinations; it does NOT warn that the form is not implemented. A client asking for header:from:asAddresses will silently receive null, which it may interpret as a missing header rather than an unimplemented feature. When a contributor implements one of these forms, they will change a previously-null field to non-null, which is technically a silent behaviour change that can break clients relying on the null. Maintenance consequence: issue reports for 'header:from:asAddresses returns null' will keep appearing.
title: apply_header_form returns null for structured forms; callers see no error
